summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. filed a Form 6-K to report the results of its ordinary shareholders' meeting held on April 28, 2026. The meeting was held remotely and attended by 48 shareholders representing 80.47% of voting rights. Resolutions included approval of financial statements for fiscal year 2025, treatment of unallocated results, and authorization for potential cash or in-kind dividends up to Ps. 190 billion. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure.
